correctness.rationale: F,G form a regular sequence fiberwise: off characteristic 3 the smooth irreducible cubic is not a factor of the product of lines; in characteristic 3 the line X+Y+Z is different from all three equality lines. Flatness can also be checked chartwise: a relation pH=aF+bG reduced modulo p forces (a,b) to be a multiple of (G,−F) modulo p by relative primality, so this multiple lifts and H lies in (F,G). There is no prime torsion. Properness and zero-dimensional fibers give finiteness and Bézout gives degree 27. Off 2,3 each pairwise cube equality gives nine disjoint points, with nonzero coordinates and independent gradients. In characteristic 2, G|E=(XYZ)³ and each coordinate line cuts three distinct simple points; e.g. at [1:λ:0] with λ³=1 the tangent is X+λ²Y=0, on which F=Z³. This proves flex multiplicity and the reduced nine-point E[3] identification. Cubing in F₄ yields 9 rational points, including exactly 3 over F₂. With any such flex as origin over F₄ a unique nonzero geometric 2-torsion point, if ordinary, would be F₄-rational, impossible for a group of order 9. Thus E[2] has length 4 at one point; coprime torsion decomposition gives length 4 at each point of E[3] in E[6], and subtracting the reduced Cartier divisor gives length 3. In characteristic 3 the equality lines meet the reduced cubic only at [1:1:1]. On X=1, substituting Y=1−v and Z=1+u+v gives exactly F=u³ and G=v⁹−u⁶v³; the quotient by (u³,v⁹) has the asserted length, Hilbert function, and complete-intersection Gorenstein structure. The local arithmetic and Hilbert function were independently replayed.
residual_risks: The fixed integral equations, not an intrinsic Hessian in characteristics 2 or 3, are verified. The elliptic group scheme interpretation applies only to the smooth characteristic-two fiber in the bad fibers.

value.rationale: The fixed polynomial model is dictated by the existing sextactic equations. Its exact special fibers distinguish a curvilinear triple thickening at each of nine flexes from a single embedding-dimension-two complete intersection; a degree count or list of support points alone cannot make that distinction. The local rings and torsion interpretation are usable information about reduction of this natural configuration.
residual_risks: No claim is made about intrinsic positive-characteristic sextactic configurations or about other models of the generic scheme.
